title: Vendedor Técnico Pleno e Novos Negócios
description:
Vendedor Técnico Pleno e Novos Negócios

Location: Diadema, São Paulo, Brazil (on-site, 50% at the office, 50% client visits)

Company: NOF Metal Coatings South America

NOF Metal Coatings South America, a leading multinational in anti-corrosion coating solutions for various industrial applications, is entering a new growth phase in the Brazilian and South American markets. With over 45 years of local presence and the distinction of being the only player in the sector with local production, we are now seeking a Technical Sales Professional to join our team and support the development of new markets while strengthening relationships with our existing customers.

The Role

Reporting to the local Sales Manager, the Technical Sales Professional will play a pivotal role in expanding our market presence, supporting licensees and clients, and aligning business development efforts with our strategic growth objectives. The position offers career development opportunities, including the possibility of assuming managerial responsibilities within approximately five years.

Interviews will be conducted exclusively in English. Fluency in Spanish or French will be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing clients and licensees.
  • Drive business development initiatives across Brazil and South America, focusing on new markets and sectors.
  • Collaborate with OEMs and suppliers on certification processes (PPAP) and ensure technical requirements are met.
  • Provide commercial and technical support to licensees for new business opportunities.
  • Work closely with international technical-commercial teams to align strategies and share best practices.
  • Support backlog management and order follow-up for licensees.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of experience in B2B technical sales, ideally in the industrial or chemical sector.
  • Strong background in the automotive industry, preferably with certification/PPAP processes or special coatings/chemical products.
  • Fluent English (oral and written) is mandatory; Spanish or French is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Metallurgical, or Chemical Engineering, or in Business Administration.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office; knowledge of Power BI and ERP systems is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously while collaborating across international teams.

Personal Profile

  • Dynamic, proactive, and resilient personality with strong customer orientation.
  • Availability for short business trips within Brazil and South America.
  • Ambition to grow into managerial responsibilities within five years.

Employment Details

  • Contract: Full-time, CLT
  • Industry: Chemical Manufacturing

title: SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) - Inglês ou espanhol avançados - 100% home office
description:
Título do cargo: SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)

Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.

Descrição da Vaga:

SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) com experiência em migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA.

Principais Responsabilidades

Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP PLM com experiência comprovada em migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA.

O candidato ideal terá sólido conhecimento em processos e integrações do SAP Product Lifecycle Management, garantindo uma transição perfeita de dados e processos.

A função requer boa comunicação em inglês (nível intermediário ou superior), além da capacidade de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais em ambientes globais.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Liderar e apoiar migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA dentro do domínio PLM.
  • Analisar os processos PLM existentes no ECC e projetar soluções otimizadas no S/4.
  • Configurar módulos do SAP PLM, incluindo Document Management System (DMS), Engineering Change Management (ECM), Product Structure Management e Recipe/Formulation Management.
  • Garantir a integração entre PLM e outros módulos (MM, PP, SD, QM).
  • Definir estratégias de migração, mapeamento e regras de transformação.
  • Preparar especificações funcionais e colaborar com as equipes ABAP e Basis para desenvolvimentos customizados.
  • Apoiar as atividades de migração de dados, validações e reconciliações.
  • Executar testes unitários, testes de integração e suporte ao UAT (User Acceptance Test) com usuários-chave.
  • Fornecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) para execução de projetos.

Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Forte conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado e/ou espanhol avançado (oral e escrito).
  • Conhecimento em aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com o SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.

Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.

Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

Como se Candidatar

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we're the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.

Role Overview

We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America, partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates' time zone

Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We're building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.

  • Fully Remote work;

  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Analista Financeiro
description:

title: Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com deficiência
description:
Banco de Talentos destinado exclusivamente a pessoas com deficiência.

O Senac é a maior instituição de educação profissional do Brasil voltada para o comércio de bens, serviços e turismo. O grupo Yokogawa, fundado no ano de 1915 em Tóquio, atualmente é líder mundial no fornecimento de soluções integradas de controle de processos. E continuamos desenvolvendo e oferecendo tecnologia no estado da arte, dentro do conceito ETS - Enterprise Technology Solutions – que significa apresentar a solução global ao cliente, pelo melhor custo/benefício.

Nosso know how internacional conta com certificação ISO:9001 e está à disposição de nossos clientes, em toda sua área de atuação, em relação à otimização da produção, dos ativos e da cadeia de suprimentos com a aplicação efetiva de tecnologias digitais, permitindo a transição para operações autônomas.

Em mais de um século de história, a Yokogawa continua trabalhando em direção a uma sociedade sustentável através de seus mais de 17.000 funcionários em uma rede global de 122 empresas que abrangem 61 países.

Yokogawa deseja uma cultura diversificada, equitativa e inclusiva. Recrutaremos, desenvolveremos e promoveremos ativamente pessoas de diversas origens que diferem em termos de experiência, conhecimento, estilos de pensamento, perspectiva, formação cultural e status socioeconômico. Não discriminaremos com base na raça, cor da pele, idade, sexo, identidade e expressão de género, orientação sexual, religião, crença, opinião política, nacionalidade, etnia, local de origem, deficiência, relações familiares ou quaisquer outras circunstâncias. A Yokogawa valoriza as diferenças e permite que todos pertençam, contribuam, tenham sucesso e demonstrem todo o seu potencial.

Ao se candidatar a esta vaga, você reconhece e concorda que a Yokogawa colete, utilize e processe seus dados pessoais para fins de recrutamento. Isso inclui a avaliação da sua adequação para a posição anunciada e a gestão de procedimentos administrativos relacionados.

Além disso, quando necessário, seus dados poderão ser compartilhados com prestadores de serviços terceirizados autorizados para a realização dessas verificações, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos legais e regulatórios aplicáveis.

A Yokogawa está comprometida em proteger sua privacidade e em tratar seus dados pessoais com os mais altos padrões de segurança e confidencialidade. Ao prosseguir com sua candidatura, você confirma que leu e compreendeu esta declaração e consente com a coleta, uso, divulgação e processamento de seus dados pessoais conforme descrito.

title: Profissional Analista de Governança Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 55508

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência em ITIL;
  • Experiência em Governança e Processos de ITSM (incidentes, mudanças e problemas);
  • Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita e eventual conversação;
  • Excelente organização, com capacidade de atuar em várias frentes simultâneas em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel para trabalhar com tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos dinâmicos, macros (VBA) e automatizações ;
  • Conhecimento de PowerBI (importação, transformação de dados e criação de dashboards)
  • Vivência em área de IT (Dev, Suporte, Infra ou correlatas);
  • Atuará de forma colaborativa com a Gestão de TI e controles internos de modo a assegurar a entrega de serviços de TI em linha com políticas e reguladores locais e globais;
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores para todos os processos com base no modelo de governança ITIL;
  • Criar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards Interagir com todos os times de IT Development (onshore) e com os times globais de ITSM (offshore).
  • CLT pela BRQ, salário a combinar+ benefícios
  • Horário das 10h as 19h (Segunda a Sexta)
  • Híbrida na Faria Lima- São Paulo (3x presencial na semana).

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Analista fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:

  • Conhecimento sobre fato gerador de impostos indiretos: ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS COFINS;
  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;
  • Vivência em apuração de impostos;
  • Conhecimento sobre direito a crédito de impostos;
  • Conhecimento em obrigações acessórias: SPED ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DIRBI
  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;
  • Experiência com sistema integrado, SAP ECC e Tax One será diferencial.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Formação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência comprovada na área fiscal;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Work, PowerPoint e Excel);

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Refeição no Local
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Senior Technical Manager - Fixed Networks & Infrastructure
description:
About This Role

We're seeking an exceptional Senior Technical Manager who will architect and orchestrate mission-critical telecommunications infrastructure that powers millions of connections across Latin America. This is your opportunity to drive technological innovation, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of fixed network solutions.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership

  • Architect and deploy carrier-grade fixed network solutions across fiber optics, GPON/EPON, SDN/NFV, and bearer network ecosystems
  • Master end-to-end bearer networks: optical transport (DWDM/OTN), metro aggregation, IP/MPLS backbone, and microwave transmission
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams (15+ engineers) driving innovation and operational excellence
  • Drive technical strategy for large-scale network transformation projects aligned with business objectives

Operational Excellence

  • Execute logical deployment strategies including provisioning, service activation, and zero-touch deployment frameworks
  • Command Tier 3/4 technical support operations with root cause analysis and incident elimination protocols
  • Optimize warranty lifecycle and spares inventory ensuring <99% equipment availability
  • Delivery measurable improvements: 99.99%+ uptime, 40%+ MTTR reduction, enhanced operational efficiency

Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.

Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations

Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment

Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction

Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)

Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge

Why Join Us

Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

Career Growth: Clear pathway to progress inside the company

Competitive Package: Industry-leading compensation aligned with performance outcomes

title: Analista de Rede Pleno

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst (BCM)
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.

With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

The main idea of this role is to protect the institution's ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.g., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees; drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil's context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.g., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes; partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.g., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)

Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

title: Rider Experience Research Expert
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: "We help people eat better, live better." Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Job Responsibilities:

Lead Rider Experience Research Initiatives:

  • Independently design research questionnaires and optimize questionnaire content by aligning with the characteristics of the rider group and research objectives.
  • Improve questionnaire response and validity rates through strategic design.
  • Regularly produce rider experience research reports that clearly present the current status, trends, and improvement directions of rider experience, providing data support for departmental decision-making.

Establish and Monitor Experience Indicators:

  • Guided by core indicators such as NPS, establish an indicator monitoring and analysis mechanism.
  • Track indicator fluctuations on a weekly/monthly basis, promptly identify anomalies, and investigate root causes.

Drive Cross-Functional Solutions:

  • For identified pain points in rider experience, collaborate with cross-functional teams including technology, product, and customer service departments.
  • Drive the development and implementation of solutions and evaluate the effectiveness of improvement measures in enhancing the rider experience.

Job Requirements:

  • Possess solid data analysis skills, capable of independently completing data extraction, cleaning, and analysis, and adept at identifying problems and opportunities from data.
  • Possess professional questionnaire design skills, able to create targeted and highly reliable/valid questionnaires based on research objectives, and have excellent report writing abilities.
  • Possess excellent cross-departmental communication and collaboration skills, able to effectively drive different teams to solve problems collaboratively, and have strong project execution capabilities and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Have empathy for the rider community, be able to think from the rider's perspective, understand the actual needs and pain points of riders in delivery fulfillment, and possess strong problem-solving skills and innovative awareness.

Position Highlights:

  • Opportunity to contribute to the rapid global expansion of Meituan's delivery business and experience accelerated professional growth.
  • Collaborate with a dynamic, international, and fast-paced team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
  • Join a respectful, hardworking, and supportive environment where continuous learning and teamwork are highly valued.

title: Analista Sr - Qualidade Pesquisa Clínica - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D'Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos cujo objetivo é contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. - Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;

description:
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com baixo nível de supervisão e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a fundo a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de média e alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.
  • Utiliza frameworks já definidos para o desenvolvimento de soluções.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Superior completo em tecnologia e afins. Desejável - cursando pós-graduação, especialização ou MBA na área de atuação.
  • Linguagem .Net e .Net Core - nível avançado;
  • Linguagem Javascript e Angular - nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados NoSQL – nível avançado;
  • Fundamento em testes unitários de end to end (e2e) - nível avançado;
  • Padrões de Projetos (design patterns) – nível intermediário;
  • Lógica de Programação - nível avançado;
  • Fundamento em testes unitários e automação de testes de software - nível avançado;
  • Arquitetura de Software (SaaS) – nível intermediário;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Regras de negócio do produto Folha de Pagamento e/ou Planejamento Orçamentário.

title: Engenheiro de processos
description:
Engenheiro (Elétrico, Produção ou Civil) – Área Técnica e Comercial

Local: Belo Horizonte

Salário inicial: R$ 4.000,00

Regime: CLT – Presencial

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um Engenheiro(a) dinâmico, com perfil técnico e comercial, para atuar em uma posição estratégica dentro da empresa. O profissional será responsável por gerenciar atividades de pós-venda, acompanhar execuções de obras e instalações, além de fiscalizar e orientar equipes diretas e terceirizadas.

Procuramos alguém com espírito de liderança, boa capacidade de comunicação e persuasão, coerência nas decisões e que saiba se posicionar com firmeza e inteligência nas relações com clientes e equipes.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Acompanhar e supervisionar execuções técnicas e comerciais;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos, qualidade e segurança nas entregas;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento técnico com clientes no pós-venda;
  • Fiscalizar equipes diretas e indiretas, garantindo o alinhamento técnico e comportamental;
  • Orientar e treinar equipes externas;
  • Apoiar a área comercial em reuniões e apresentações técnicas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Civil ou de Produção (com registro ativo no CREA);
  • Experiência com obras, instalações, ou projetos técnicos;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de liderança e resolução de problemas;
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e com visão sistêmica.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de engenharia, construção ou iluminação;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de equipes e obras;
  • Habilidade em negociação e pós-venda técnico.

Se você tem perfil técnico, gosta de liderar e busca uma posição desafiadora, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe

title: HR Operation Senior Specialist
description:
【Responsibilities】

1. HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.

Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.

Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

2. HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.

Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

3. Quality Controal & Employee Experience:

- Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.

- Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.

- Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.

- Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.

【Requirements】

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master's degree is a plus.

- 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.

- Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.

- Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.

- Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

【Highlights】

- Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.

- Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.

- Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.

- Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

title: Bolsista Graduado - DALL PHYTOLAB - Desenvolvimento de métodos analíticos | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolverbolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Você tem interesse em desenvolver métodos analíticos inovadores e contribuir diretamente para a evolução da indústria de suplementos alimentares? A Dall PhytoLab S.A., empresa em expansão e referência em análises laboratoriais, está com uma oportunidade única para quem deseja atuar em projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento e validação de métodos robustos para quantificação de ativos em suplementos.

Estamos em busca de um bolsista para conduzir atividades de pesquisa aplicada com foco em técnicas cromatográficas e espectrofotométricas, atuando no desenvolvimento, otimização e validação de métodos analíticos que possam ser internalizados e replicados pela equipe. O projeto tem como objetivo reduzir a dependência de serviços terceirizados, aumentar a eficiência dos processos internos e ampliar o portfólio de serviços do laboratório, impactando diretamente indicadores como redução de custos, otimização do time-to-market e maior flexibilidade para novas formulações.

Se você busca uma oportunidade de aprendizado prático, quer se desenvolver em um ambiente de excelência técnica e contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para o setor de suplementos, essa oportunidade é para você!

Projeto:

Desenvolvimento e otimização de métodos analíticos para quantificação de ingredientes ativos em suplementos alimentares.

Formação Acadêmica:

Graduado em Química ou Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;

Idioma: Inglês para leitura técnica.

Principais Atividades:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e validação dos métodos;
  • Estruturando a documentação técnica;
  • Capacitando a equipe e reduzindo a dependência externa.

Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários:

  • Graduação em Química ou Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos;
  • Conhecimento em RDCs da ANVISA
  • Técnicas cromatográficas (HPLC, CG) e espectroscópicas.

Ferramentas/metodologias:

  • HPLC, UV/VIS;
  • Validação analítica segundo normas ISO/ANVISA;

Conhecimentos e habilidades desejáveis:

  • Design of Experiments (DoE);
  • Desejável mestrado na área;
  • Operação de GC;

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista R$ 4.000,00

Formato de trabalho: Presencial.

Local: Curitiba/PR

title: Sales Operation
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  • Sales Target Management: Break down the team's business objectives and identify key sales indicators that impact the team's ability to achieve these targets. Establish a target management system and utilize efficient data tools and organizational methods to manage the team's daily, weekly, and monthly sales goals.
  • Responsible for collecting, organizing, and analyzing sales data, regularly producing sales analysis reports to support business decision-making.
  • Participate in the construction and maintenance of sales data dashboards, assisting in building data management systems to improve data efficiency and visualization.
  • Support supervisors in building, optimizing, and maintaining sales management data, driving efficiency improvement through data-driven management.
  • Responsible for the collection, organization, and archiving of sales-related data to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Handle various sales support tasks as assigned by supervisors, including but not limited to data statistics, report generation, process optimization, and daily administrative support.
  • Assist the team in tracking business progress, collecting and feeding back issues, ensuring smooth information channels and timely issue resolution.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above, with a preference for majors in data analysis, statistics, finance, or related fields;
  • 3years or more of work experience in sales support, data analysis, or operational management;
  • Proficient in using data analysis and visualization tools, experience in data dashboard construction is preferred;
  • Possess good communication and coordination skills as well as teamwork spirit, able to efficiently support cross departmental collaboration.

Job Highlights

  • Deep involvement in team management and business process optimization,contributing to core business goals.
  • Join an international team,collaborate with colleagues from 26 countries,and enhance global vision and cross-cultural abilities.
  • Be part of an early-stage business,face diverse challenges and growth opportunities,and quickly advance personal capabilities.

title: Analista de Engenharia de Riscos - Obras & Infraestrutura
description:
A área de Gerenciamento e Monitoramento de Riscos GMR na seguradora é responsável por acompanhar de perto grandes obras, realizando visitas técnicas e monitorando indicadores de desempenho, com foco no gerenciamento de valor agregado para manter uma visão ampla e estratégica do andamento dos projetos. Além disso, atua diretamente no apoio à equipe em situações de sinistro, garantindo suporte na análise e condução dos casos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Análise técnica prévia de riscos em obras públicas, incluindo avaliação de editais, cronogramas (caminho crítico), fornecedores e requisitos técnicos antes do início da execução;

Monitoramento de obras já seguradas, por meio de visitas técnicas, aplicação de indicadores de desempenho (como EVM) e elaboração de relatórios sobre evolução e riscos

Monitoramento de indicadores: analisar prazos, custos e qualidade, aplicando ferramentas de gerenciamento de valor agregado para identificar desvios.

Análise de riscos: avaliar riscos técnicos e operacionais das obras, propondo medidas preventivas.

Apoio em casos de sinistro: atuar em conjunto com a equipe de sinistros para fornecer informações técnicas, documentos e evidências que ajudem na condução do caso.

Relatórios e pareceres técnicos: consolidar dados e apresentar insights sobre a evolução das obras e riscos envolvidos.

Interlocução com áreas internas: manter contato com equipes de engenharia, sinistros, subscrição e eventualmente clientes, garantindo alinhamento.

Sugestão de melhorias: propor ajustes em processos de acompanhamento e controles, com base em análises.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatório:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Civil
  • Experiência prévia em acompanhamento de obras: acompanhamento técnico, análise de editais, cronogramas, orçamentos;
  • Vivência prática em identificação de problemas e riscos em obras: atrasos, falhas de fornecedores, gargalos de cronograma, questões técnicas;
  • Excel avançado: para análise de dados, orçamentos, indicadores;
  • Conhecimento em MS Project, Primavera ou similares;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais;
  • Acompanhamento da gestão de terceirizados.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento no segmento de seguros de obras, riscos de engenharia ou sinistros será diferencial, mas não obrigatório;
  • Familiaridade com EVM (Earned Value Management);
  • Experiência com licitações e leilões de obras públicas;
  • Vivência em gestão de contratos e subempreiteiros.

Informações adicionais

Pacote de Benefícios:

title: Technical Project Engineer
description:
About Invisto

Invisto is a real estate investment platform focused on urban infill developments in the U.S., specializing in high-end single-family homes in desirable, established neighborhoods in Florida — including Winter Park, Orlando, and Tampa.

One of our key differentiators is our commitment to architecture and design. We work with a team of experienced in-house and external architects and designers to develop our projects. Our close collaboration with U.S.-based construction teams and American engineers ensures full integration across disciplines. We also stay connected to the cutting edge of American residential design — constantly monitoring trends, influencers, and the preferences of high-end homebuyers.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and driven Civil Engineer to join our high-end residential design team in Florida (USA).

This is a unique opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating closely with architects, engineers, and local consultants to bring exceptional homes to life in some of Florida's most prestigious neighborhoods.

The professional will be responsible for supporting the technical development, 3D modeling, and coordination of all project disciplines, ensuring that every solution aligns with the defined scope, quality standards, and local building codes.

We seek someone with strong analytical skills, solid technical background, and a construction-oriented mindset, capable of anticipating design conflicts, proposing smart solutions, and contributing to the excellence of our residential projects.

Main responsibilities

  • Review and coordinate architectural, structural, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) plans.
  • Develop and/or review the 3D modeling of complementary disciplines, ensuring proper coordination and clash detection across all systems.
  • Ensure full alignment and compatibility between all design disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Follow up on outstanding items with external designers, engineers, and suppliers.
  • Provide technical guidance to the architectural team during project development.
  • Support the construction team with technical input during field execution.
  • Assist in technical decisions related to finishes, materials, and equipment.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering.
  • Advanced English.
  • Experience in development and coordination of construction projects.
  • Solid knowledge of applicable codes and technical standards.
  • Strong communication skills, organizational ability, and proactivity.
  • Experience with high-end residential projects and grading projects would be an advantage.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing company and a reference in urban infill development in the U.S.
  • A learning-driven environment with direct collaboration between U.S. and Brazil-based teams.
  • Real potential for international career growth.
  • A dynamic, high-performance, entrepreneurial culture.
  • Hybrid work model: remote flexibility combined with in-office presence in São Paulo/SP.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we've defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Senior-level:

description:

Analista de Recursos Humanos

Resumo da Posição

O(a) profissional atuará como Analista de Recursos Humanos, apoiando a operação local e contribuindo para a consolidação da estrutura organizacional da empresa no Brasil. Será responsável por garantir a execução eficiente das rotinas de RH e por fortalecer a cultura corporativa, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, ético e alinhado aos valores globais da G Mining Services.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Apoiar todo o ciclo de recrutamento e seleção, desde a divulgação das vagas até o onboarding.
  • Manter e atualizar registros e contratos de colaboradores (CLT e prestadores de serviço).
  • Apoiar nas rotinas de folha de pagamento, controle de ponto, férias, benefícios e rescisões.
  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos (saúde, odontológico, alimentação, transporte e seguro de vida), incluindo controles mensais, inclusões e exclusões.
  • Apoiar nas relações trabalhistas e garantir conformidade com a legislação brasileira (CLT).
  • Apoiar na organização e execução de ações de integração, treinamentos e iniciativas de engajamento.
  • Contribuir com ideias e auxiliar na implementação de programas de bem-estar e cultura que fortaleçam a experiência do colaborador.
  • Preparar relatórios e indicadores de RH (headcount, benefícios, custos de pessoal etc.) para suporte à gestão.
  • Colaborar com as equipes globais de RH e Administração, mantendo uma comunicação eficaz em inglês.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em rotinas generalistas de RH.
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista (CLT) e práticas administrativas de RH.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado, para comunicação frequente com equipes internacionais.
  • Boa habilidade com Excel e ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

Perfil desejado

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade e atitude colaborativa.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Empatia, integridade e genuíno interesse por pessoas.
  • Flexibilidade e perfil "mão na massa".

Informações Adicionais

A posição será baseada no escritório da G Mining Services em Belo Horizonte, Brasil. A empresa busca profissionais dinâmicos e motivados que desejam integrar uma equipe experiente e comprometida com o sucesso de seus projetos.

Benefícios

  • Reembolso de atividades esportivas.
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Atividades sociais e de integração.

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

G Mining Services is a multidisciplinary company that provides professional services to the mining sector, working on both open-pit and underground projects involving precious, base, and industrial metals. Recognized as one of Canada's leading mining engineering consultancies and among the most respected in international projects, G Mining is expanding and strengthening its presence in Brazil.

Following the success of the Tocantinzinho Mine project, the company is opening a new office in the country to collaborate with local talent on future projects in Brazil and abroad.

As a family-owned company, G Mining values its employees by promoting both professional and personal development through unique career opportunities, collaboration, and a welcoming, safe, and inclusive work environment.

Human Resources Analyst

Position Summary

The professional will serve as a Human Resources Analyst, supporting local operations and contributing to the consolidation of the company's organizational structure in Brazil. They will be responsible for ensuring the efficient execution of HR routines and for strengthening the corporate culture, fostering a collaborative, ethical, and value-driven work environment aligned with G Mining Services' global standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the entire recruitment and selection cycle, from job posting to onboarding.

  • Assist with payroll, time tracking, vacation, benefits, and termination processes.
  • Administer corporate benefits (health, dental, meal, transportation, and life insurance), including monthly controls, enrollments, and removals.
  • Support labor relations and ensure compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT).
  • Organize and execute integration, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas and assist in implementing wellness and culture programs that enhance the employee experience.
  • Prepare HR reports and metrics (headcount, benefits, personnel costs, etc.) to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with global HR and Administration teams, maintaining effective communication in English.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Psychology, Human Resources, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in generalist HR routines.
  • Solid knowledge of labor legislation (CLT) and HR administrative practices.
  • Intermediate to advanced English level for frequent communication with international teams.
  • Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office tools.

Desired Profile

  • Organization and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Empathy, integrity, and genuine interest in people.
  • Flexibility and hands-on mindset.

Additional Information

The position will be based at G Mining Services' office in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. The company seeks dynamic and motivated professionals who wish to join an experienced team committed to project success.

Benefits

  • Individual and corporate performance bonuses.
  • Health and dental plans for employees and their families.
  • Reimbursement for sports activities.
  • Training and professional development programs.
  • Social and integration activities.

title: Financial Manager
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

China Unicom Brazil is a subsidiary of China Unicom Global, a leading international telecommunications and ICT service provider. We deliver cross-border data connectivity, cloud and network solutions, ICT installation services, and technical support to multinational enterprises operating between China, Brazil, and the broader Latin America region. With strong global resources and local expertise, we are committed to providing reliable services, enabling digital transformation, and building a diverse, collaborative workplace.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Financial Manager; Work Location: São Paulo, Brazil

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Tax Accounting: Calculate the Brazilian company's profits tax monthly and record the profits tax entries accordingly; prepare the Brazilian company's annual income tax return, including tax agent bidding, contract signing, providing tax calculation data, and filing tax documents.
  • Tax Planning: Lead the Brazilian tax planning work and provide relevant consulting support on Brazilian tax issues.
  • Tax Policy Support: Provide Brazilian tax policy support to the local operations team of the Brazilian company; lead the research and management document issuance of Brazilian tax policies.
  • Tax Training: Report the tax risk situation to management regularly and provide corresponding suggestions; organize regional tax training quarterly to improve the team's risk awareness and response capabilities.
  • Tax Audit and Inspection: Responsible for the external audit of the Brazilian company; lead the liaison with the superior unit for tax audits and tax statistics; regularly report on the problems found in internal and external audits and inspections and the rectification status.
  • Tax Intermediary Management: Responsible for coordinating outsourcing of tax consulting and other services in Brazil, proposing procurement needs, supervising the implementation of Brazilian tax outsourcing procurement tenders, tracking the service quality of tax outsourcing agencies monthly, and outputting evaluation results.
  • Risk Management: Ensure that the company's tax declarations and payments in Brazil strictly comply with local laws and regulations to avoid fines or legal disputes caused by violations; proactively assess potential tax risks brought about by business changes (such as new market entry, mergers and acquisitions, and business model adjustments), including key areas such as transfer pricing, permanent establishments, and indirect taxes; formulate and implement regional tax risk management policies and internal control mechanisms to ensure the accuracy of tax data and the standardization of processes, and reduce the risk of operational errors; lead the handling of tax audits, investigations, or litigation cases, communicate and coordinate with local tax authorities, control the escalation of disputes, and reduce financial losses.
  • Tax File Management: In accordance with the regulatory requirements of Brazilian government agencies, complete the organization of tax-related vouchers; revise and summarize tax-related operation manuals.
  • Complete other tasks assigned by superiors.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum Relevant Educational Degree: Bachelor's Degree
  • Relevant Major: Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analysis, Finance, Computer Science
  • Relevant Professional Knowledge or Skills: Accounting, Statistics, Computer Science
  • Preferred Relevant Work Experience: At least 3 years of experience in Brazilian tax-related work
  • Qualifications and Certifications: Intermediate Accountant or Chinese/overseas CPA/ACCA professional qualification or above, Tax Agent Qualification
  • Language Requirements: Chinese, English
  • Other Requirements: Brazilian work experience, valid work visa

Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

The Sr. Associate - Regulatory Compliance is responsible for monitoring emerging regulations, regulatory changes, new product impact assessments, and ensuring timely compliance planning. This role partners with legal, product, risk, and operations teams to ensure products and processes meet regulatory expectations. Experience with Bacen authorization/regulatory licensing processes is a strong advantage.

Responsibilities

1. Regulatory Monitoring & Interpretation

  • Monitor and interpret new laws, regulations, and regulatory trends issued by Bacen, CMN, CVM, COAF, Receita Federal, and industry bodies (e.g., Febraban).
  • Translate regulatory requirements into internal impact assessments and action plans.
  • Prepare concise and executive-level regulatory briefings for senior management and group governance.

2. Product Advisory & Gap Analysis

  • Conduct regulatory gap assessments of new products, features, partnerships, and business initiatives.
  • Provide Compliance advisory to Product and Business on regulatory obligations and risk mitigation for launches.
  • Ensure regulatory requirements are embedded throughout the product lifecycle and documented in internal controls.

3. Controls, Policies & Documentation

  • Maintain regulatory compliance policies and oversee periodic review and alignment with local and group policies.
  • Maintain the Regulatory Obligations Register and track compliance with requirements.
  • Coordinate the internal compliance control testing plan and follow-up on remediation.

4. Regulatory Relationships & Licensing Support

  • Support regulatory engagements, preparation of materials, and responses to RFIs or supervisory communications.
  • Contribute to regulatory authorization projects, leading regulatory assessments, documentation, and compliance readiness.

Skills, Experiences & Qualifications

  • Strong regulatory interpretation and simplification skills.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Strategic mindset with high organization and ownership.
  • Bachelor's degree in law, Public Policy, Business, Economics, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Regulatory Compliance within financial services or fintechs.
  • Strong understanding of Bacen & CMN regulations and regulatory expectations.
  • Experience contributing to Bacen authorization or licensing processes is highly valued.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).

title: M365 Consultant
description:

About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP delivering enterprise-grade Microsoft 365, Azure, and multi-cloud solutions to global clients.

As a Microsoft 365 Consultant, you'll take end-to-end ownership of operational, architectural, administrative, and consultative responsibilities across enterprise M365 environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and advisory position — blending technical depth with strategic consulting. You'll work directly with enterprise clients to keep their Microsoft 365 ecosystems secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

This is not a traditional support role — you'll engage directly with customers, provide insights on modernization, and shape the future of their Microsoft 365 environments.

What You'll Bring

Who You Are

  • A consultative communicator comfortable advising enterprise clients directly

  • A continuous learner, always keeping up with new Microsoft releases and best practices

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Work fully remote from anywhere

  • Long-term engagement with enterprise US clients
  • Focus on certification and career growth (Microsoft exams covered every 6 months)
  • Exposure to advanced Microsoft environments and governance frameworks
  • Collaborative, senior-level culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy
